input: token-major FP32 projected query, key, value, and query-gate rows with shared direct RMSNorm scales

causal_chunk_protocol.committed_prefix: contexts before start_position read the committed BF16 cache
causal_chunk_protocol.candidate_prefix: contexts from start_position through the current token read earlier rows in the same candidate chunk
causal_chunk_protocol.prepare: all candidate K/V rows and outputs are produced without changing committed cache or frontier
causal_chunk_protocol.commit: copy every candidate row into its final contiguous cache range, synchronize, then publish the final frontier

workspace.candidate_values: token_count * kv_heads * head_width for each of K and V

not_claimed: complete 16-layer KV allocation with model weights and graphs
